findings.evidence: Existing `hurewiczAddEquiv_apply` (Absolute.lean:165) only reaches `(hurewiczHom ...).hom 1`, and `hurewiczIntHom_map` (Basic.lean:709) is stated for `hurewiczIntHom`, so the PR proof has to cross between them by unfolding in both directions.
findings.fix: In `Hurewicz/Absolute.lean`, add `hurewiczAddEquiv_apply_eq_hurewiczIntHom : hurewiczAddEquiv hX a = hurewiczIntHom X x (n + 1) a`, or better a naturality lemma `hurewiczAddEquiv_map` stated for `hurewiczAddEquiv`. Then rebuild the proof as a short composition using it and `hurewiczIntHom_map`.
findings.issue: In `exists_sphereWedge_singularHomologyMap_eq`, the first and third `calc` steps both convert between `hurewiczAddEquiv` and `hurewiczIntHom` with brittle rewrite chains (`hurewiczAddEquiv_apply`, `hurewiczIntHom_apply`, `hurewiczHom_apply`, `toMul_ofMul`, forward and reversed). This hides a reusable fact and makes the proof about 30 lines long.

findings.evidence: `diskBoundaryInclusion_comp_diskMap` (CubeQuotient.lean:667) rewrites the right-hand side to `TopCat.ofHom (ContinuousMap.const _ x)`. The left-hand side is a composite, and nothing but definitional unfolding closes the goal.
findings.fix: Replace each with an explicit step (`ext; simp`, or `ConcreteCategory.comp_apply`/`ContinuousMap.const_apply`), or add a comment explaining why `rfl` holds.
findings.issue: In `sphereWedgeLift`, the side condition closes with `rfl` after `rw [GenLoop.diskBoundaryInclusion_comp_diskMap]`, relying on `sphereWedgeAttachingMap ι n i ≫ TopCat.ofHom (const _ z)` being definitionally `TopCat.ofHom (const _ z)`. In `sphereWedgeLift_sphereWedgeBase` (line ~324), `rfl` likewise evaluates `TopCat.ofHom (ContinuousMap.const _ z) PUnit.unit`. Neither `rfl` is documented.

summary: The proof of the homology realization theorem twice unfolds Hurewicz definitions to work around a missing lemma relating `hurewiczAddEquiv` to `hurewiczIntHom`. Two closing `rfl`s also rely on undocumented definitional equality of constant maps.
